intro.en: This reading says cleanliness is needed in everything. Islam urges us to keep our body, clothes, home, mosque and streets clean. Notice how purity is a condition for prayer and for touching the Quran.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum parhenge ke safai har cheez mein zaroori hai. Islam hamein apna jism, kapde, ghar, masjid aur raste saaf rakhne ka hukm deta hai. Dhyan dein: namaz aur Quran ko chhoone ke liye paaki shart hai.
intro.ar: تُبَيِّنُ هَذِهِ القِراءَةُ أَنَّ النَّظافَةَ مَطْلوبَةٌ في كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالإِسْلامُ يَحُثُّنا عَلى نَظافَةِ البَدَنِ وَالثِّيابِ وَالبَيْتِ وَالمَسْجِدِ وَالشّارِعِ. وَلاحِظْ أَنَّ الطَّهارَةَ شَرْطٌ لِلصَّلاةِ.

dialogue.ar: النَّظافَةُ مَطْلوبَةٌ في كُلِّ شَيْءٍ: في الجَسَدِ وَالمَلابِسِ وَالمَسْكَنِ وَالطَّريقِ.
dialogue.tr: an-naẓāfatu maṭlūbatun fī kulli shayʾ: fil-jasadi wal-malābisi wal-maskani waṭ-ṭarīq
dialogue.en: Cleanliness is required in everything: in the body, clothes, home and road.
dialogue.ur: Safai har cheez mein matloob hai: jism, libas, ghar aur raaste mein.

dialogue.ar: يَحْرِصُ المُسْلِمُ عَلى نَظافَةِ جَسَدِهِ، فَيَغْسِلُ يَدَيْهِ إِلى المِرْفَقَيْنِ وَيَقُصُّ أَظافِرَهُ.
dialogue.tr: yaḥriṣul-muslimu ʿalā naẓāfati jasadih, fa-yaghsilu yadayhi ilal-mirfaqayni wa yaquṣṣu aẓfārah
dialogue.en: A Muslim takes care that his body is clean: he washes his hands up to the elbows and trims his nails.
dialogue.ur: Musalman apne jism ki safai ka khayal rakhta hai: woh haath kohniyon tak dhota hai aur naakhun kaatta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَعْتَني بِفَمِهِ وَأَسْنانِهِ، فَيَسْتَعْمِلُ السِّواكَ لِتَزولَ الرَّوائِحُ الكَريهَةُ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaʿtanī bi-famihi wa asnānih, fa-yastaʿmilus-siwāka li-tazūlar-rawāʾiḥul-karīhah
dialogue.en: He cares for his mouth and teeth and uses the siwak so that bad smells go away.
dialogue.ur: Woh apne munh aur daanton ka khayal rakhta hai aur miswak istemal karta hai taake badboo door ho.

dialogue.ar: السِّواكُ مَطْهَرَةٌ لِلْفَمِ، مَرْضاةٌ لِلرَّبِّ
dialogue.tr: as-siwāku maṭharatun lil-fam, marḍātun lir-rabb
dialogue.en: The siwak cleanses the mouth and pleases the Lord.
dialogue.ur: Miswak munh ko paak karne wala aur Rab ko razi karne wala hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَحْرِصُ عَلى نَظافَةِ مَلابِسِهِ وَمَسْكَنِهِ فَلا يَتْرُكُ فيهِما الأَوْساخَ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaḥriṣu ʿalā naẓāfati malābisihi wa maskanihi fa-lā yatruku fīhimal-awsākh
dialogue.en: He keeps his clothes and home clean and does not leave dirt in them.
dialogue.ur: Woh apne libas aur ghar ki safai ka khayal rakhta hai aur unmein ganda nahi chhorta.

dialogue.ar: الطُّهورُ شَطْرُ الإيمانِ
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭuhūru shaṭrul-īmān
dialogue.en: Purity is half of faith.
dialogue.ur: Pakeezgi iman ka aadha hissa hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالطَّهارَةُ شَرْطٌ لِلصَّلاةِ، فَيَتَطَهَّرُ المُسْلِمُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقِفَ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: waṭ-ṭahāratu sharṭun liṣ-ṣalāh, fa-yataṭahharul-muslimu qabla an yaqifa bayna yadayi llāh
dialogue.en: Purity is a condition for prayer, so the Muslim purifies himself before standing before Allah.
dialogue.ur: Taharat namaz ki shart hai, isliye musalman Allah ke huzoor khare hone se pehle paak hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلا تَقِفُ النَّظافَةُ عِنْدَ البَدَنِ، فَالمَسْجِدُ بَيْتُ اللهِ وَيَنْبَغي أَنْ يَبْقى طاهِراً طَيِّبَ الرّائِحَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa lā taqifun-naẓāfatu ʿindal-badan, fal-masjidu baytu llāhi wa yanbaghī an yabqā ṭāhiran ṭayyiba r-rāʾiḥah
dialogue.en: Cleanliness does not stop at the body: the mosque is the house of Allah and should stay pure and sweet-smelling.
dialogue.ur: Safai sirf jism par nahi rukti: masjid Allah ka ghar hai aur use paak aur khushboodar rehna chahiye.

dialogue.ar: وَالطَّريقُ مِلْكٌ لِلنّاسِ جَميعاً، فَمَنْ رَمى فيهِ الأَوْساخَ آذَى المارّينَ.
dialogue.tr: waṭ-ṭarīqu milkun lin-nāsi jamīʿan, fa-man ramā fīhil-awsākha ādal-mārrīn
dialogue.en: The road belongs to everyone, so whoever throws dirt in it harms the passers-by.
dialogue.ur: Raasta sab logon ka hai, isliye jo us mein ganda phenke woh guzarne walon ko takleef deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَجَعَلَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ إِزالَةَ الأَذى عَنِ الطَّريقِ صَدَقَةً.
dialogue.tr: wa jaʿalar-rasūlu izālatal-adhā ʿaniṭ-ṭarīqi ṣadaqah
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ made removing harm from the road a charity.
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne raaste se takleef-deh cheez hatane ko sadqa qarar diya.

dialogue.ar: وَهكَذا يَجْتَمِعُ الحَياءُ وَالنَّظافَةُ وَالإيمانُ في شَخْصِيَّةِ المُسْلِمِ.
dialogue.tr: wa hākadhā yajtamiʿul-ḥayāʾu wan-naẓāfatu wal-īmānu fī shakhṣiyyatil-muslim
dialogue.en: So modesty, cleanliness and faith come together in the character of the Muslim.
dialogue.ur: Yun haya, safai aur iman musalman ki shakhsiyat mein jama ho jate hain.

q.en: What does the text say is necessary in everything?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq har cheez mein kya zaroori hai?
q.ar: ما الَّذي يَقولُ النَّصُّ إِنَّهُ ضَرورِيٌّ في كُلِّ شَيْءٍ؟

q.ur: «السِّواكُ» kis liye hai?

options: Cleaning the mouth / Munh ki safai
Sweeping the road / Sadak saaf karna

q.ur: «الأَسْنانُ» ka matlab?

options_ar: ما في الفَمِ وَنَمْضُغُ بِهِ الطَّعامَ

q.ur: Namaz ke baghair kya qabool nahin?

q.en: What did the Messenger call us to remove from the road?
q.ur: Rasool ne raste se kya hataane ko kaha?
q.ar: ماذا دَعانا الرَّسولُ ﷺ إِلى إِزالَتِهِ عَنِ الطَّريقِ؟

options: What harms people / Jo takleef de

intro.en: Wonder (ta'ajjub) is expressed with «ما أَفْعَلَ ...!». Take a verb like جَمُلَ (to be beautiful) and say «ما أَجْمَلَ السَّماءَ!» - How beautiful the sky is! Another form is «أَفْعِلْ بِـ ...!», e.g. «أَجْمِلْ بِهِ!». Then practise turning verbs and sentences into wonder sentences.
intro.ur: Ta'ajjub (hairat) «ما أَفْعَلَ ...!» se zaahir kiya jata hai. Misaal: «ما أَجْمَلَ السَّماءَ!» yani aasman kitna khoobsurat hai! Doosra andaaz «أَفْعِلْ بِـ ...!» hai, jaise «أَجْمِلْ بِهِ!». Phir mashq mein fe'l aur jumlon ko ta'ajjub ke jumlon mein badalna hai.
intro.ar: نُعَبِّرُ عَنِ التَّعَجُّبِ بِصيغَةِ «ما أَفْعَلَ ...!». نَأْخُذُ فِعْلًا مِثْلَ «جَمُلَ» وَنَقولُ «ما أَجْمَلَ السَّماءَ!». وَصيغَةٌ أُخْرى هِيَ «أَفْعِلْ بِـ ...!» مِثْلُ «أَجْمِلْ بِهِ!». ثُمَّ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى تَحْويلِ الأَفْعالِ وَالجُمَلِ إِلى جُمَلِ تَعَجُّبٍ.

dialogue.ar: ما أَجْمَلَ القَمَرَ في اللَّيْلَةِ الصّافِيَةِ!
dialogue.tr: mā ajmalal-qamara fil-laylatiṣ-ṣāfiyah
dialogue.en: How beautiful the moon is on a clear night!
dialogue.ur: Saaf raat mein chand kitna khoobsurat hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَحْسَنَ الصِّدْقَ في الحَديثِ!
dialogue.tr: mā aḥsanaṣ-ṣidqa fil-ḥadīth
dialogue.en: How good truthfulness in speech is!
dialogue.ur: Baat mein sach kitna acha hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَعْدَلَ هَذا القاضِيَ في حُكْمِهِ!
dialogue.tr: mā aʿdala hādhal-qāḍiya fī ḥukmih
dialogue.en: How just this judge is in his ruling!
dialogue.ur: Yeh qazi apne faisle mein kitna adil hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَشَدَّ الازْدِحامَ عِنْدَ بابِ المَدْرَسَةِ ظُهْراً!
dialogue.tr: mā ashaddal-izdiḥāma ʿinda bābil-madrasati ẓuhrā
dialogue.en: How heavy the crowding at the school gate is at noon!
dialogue.ur: Dopahar ko school ke darwaze par kitni bheed hoti hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَقْبَحَ بُخْلَ الغَنِيِّ عَلى الفَقيرِ!
dialogue.tr: mā aqbaḥa bukhlal-ghaniyyi ʿalal-faqīr
dialogue.en: How ugly the rich man’s stinginess toward the poor is!
dialogue.ur: Ameer ka gareeb par kanjoosi karna kitna bura hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَنْفَعَ العِلْمَ لِلنّاسِ!
dialogue.tr: mā anfaʿal-ʿilma lin-nās
dialogue.en: How beneficial knowledge is to people!
dialogue.ur: Ilm logon ke liye kitna faidemand hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَجْمَلَ الوَرْدَ في الحَديقَةِ!
dialogue.tr: mā ajmalal-warda fil-ḥadīqah
dialogue.en: How beautiful the roses are in the garden!
dialogue.ur: Bagh mein gulab kitne khoobsurat hain!

dialogue.ar: أَحْسِنْ بِالأَمَلِ رَفيقاً لِلإِنْسانِ!
dialogue.tr: aḥsin bil-amali rafīqan lil-insān
dialogue.en: How good hope is as a companion to a person!
dialogue.ur: Insaan ke liye umeed kitni achhi saathi hai!

dialogue.ar: أَجْمِلْ بِالاسْتِقامَةِ خُلُقاً!
dialogue.tr: ajmil bil-istiqāmati khuluqā
dialogue.en: How beautiful uprightness is as a character trait!
dialogue.ur: Istiqamat bataur akhlaq kitni khoobsurat hai!

dialogue.ar: أَقْبِحْ بِالكَذِبِ عادَةً!
dialogue.tr: aqbiḥ bil-kadhibi ʿādah
dialogue.en: How ugly lying is as a habit!
dialogue.ur: Jhoot bolna bataur aadat kitna bura hai!

dialogue.ar: لِلّهِ دَرُّكَ مِنْ حارِسٍ أَمينٍ!
dialogue.tr: lillāhi darruka min ḥārisin amīn
dialogue.en: Allah bless you, what a trustworthy guard!
dialogue.ur: Allah tujhe barkat de, kya amanatdar nigehban hai!

dialogue.ar: سُبْحانَ اللهِ!
dialogue.tr: subḥāna llāh
dialogue.en: Glory be to Allah!
dialogue.ur: Subhan Allah!

q.ur: Kaun sa jumla ta'ajjub ka hai?

q.en: What does «ما أَحْسَنَ الصِّدْقَ في الحَديثِ!» mean?
q.ur: «ما أَحْسَنَ الصِّدْقَ في الحَديثِ!» ka kya matlab hai?
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «ما أَحْسَنَ الصِّدْقَ في الحَديثِ!»؟

options: How good truthfulness in speech is! / Baat mein sach kitna acha hai!
What is truthfulness? / Sach kya hai?
He is truthful / Woh sacha hai
options_ar: التَّعَجُّبُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الصِّدْقِ في الحَديثِ

q.en: The second form of wonder starts with:
q.ur: Ta'ajjub ki doosri shakl kis se shuru hoti hai?
«البُخْلُ» ka matlab:
Kaunsa jumla kisi ki tareef karta hai, jaise ‘shabash’?

title.en: Listening: The Ant and the Sweets; Abu Sufyan and Heraclius
title.ur: Sunna: Cheenti aur mithai; Abu Sufyan aur Heraclius

intro.en: Here you listen to two texts and answer true/false questions: a story about ants and a sweet (الحَلْوى) in the forest, and the famous meeting of Abu Sufyan with Heraclius (هِرَقْل), the ruler of the Romans, who asked him about Muhammad. Play the audio, then check the answers.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do matn sun kar sahi/ghalat ke sawalat hal karne hain: ek cheentiyon aur mithai ki kahani, aur doosra Abu Sufyan aur Heraclius (Rome ke badshah) ki mashhoor mulaqat, jis mein usne Muhammad ﷺ ke baare mein poocha. Audio sunein, phir jawab dekhein.
intro.ar: في هَذا الدَّرْسِ تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى نَصَّيْنِ وَتُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ: قِصَّةُ النَّمْلِ وَالحَلْوى في الغابَةِ، وَلِقاءُ أَبي سُفْيانَ بِهِرَقْلَ مَلِكِ الرّومِ الَّذي سَأَلَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ. شَغِّلِ الصَّوْتَ ثُمَّ تَحَقَّقْ مِنَ الإِجاباتِ.

q.ur: Heraclius (هِرَقْل) kaun hai?

options: Ruler of the Romans / Rumiyon ka badshah

q.ur: «النَّمْلُ» ka matlab?
«الحَلْوى» ka matlab?

q.en: Heraclius sent for Abu Sufyan to ask him about...
q.ur: Heraclius ne Abu Sufyan ko kis ke baare mein poochne bulaya?
q.ar: اسْتَدْعى هِرَقْلُ أَبا سُفْيانَ لِيَسْأَلَهُ عَنْ...

q.ur: «الجُنودُ» ka matlab?

intro.en: This section gives tips for a good speech (khutba) and then asks you to prepare and deliver one. Good speeches are prepared, stay on one topic, use clear Arabic, give proofs and examples, and are not too long.
intro.ur: Is hisse mein achi khutba ke liye mashwarey hain, phir khutba tayyar karke sunana hai. Achi khutba pehle se tayyar hoti hai, ek mauzu par rehti hai, saaf Arabic mein hoti hai, daleel aur misaal deti hai aur lambi nahin hoti.
intro.ar: يُقَدِّمُ هَذا القِسْمُ نَصائِحَ لِلخُطْبَةِ الجَيِّدَةِ ثُمَّ يَطْلُبُ مِنْكَ أَنْ تُعِدَّ خُطْبَةً وَتُلْقِيَها. الخُطْبَةُ الجَيِّدَةُ مُعَدَّةٌ، وَتَدورُ حَوْلَ مَوْضوعٍ واحِدٍ، وَبِعَرَبِيَّةٍ واضِحَةٍ، وَفيها أَدِلَّةٌ وَأَمْثِلَةٌ، وَلَيْسَتْ طَويلَةً.

dialogue.ar: حَضِّرِ الخُطْبَةَ قَبْلَ يَوْمِها حَتّى تُرَتِّبَ أَفْكارَكَ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍḍiril-khuṭbata qabla yawmihā ḥattā turatkiba afkārak
dialogue.en: Prepare the speech before its day so that you arrange your ideas.
dialogue.ur: Khutba ko uske din se pehle tayyar karo taake apne khayalat tarteeb de sako.

dialogue.ar: اِبْقَ في مَوْضوعٍ واحِدٍ وَلا تَنْتَقِلْ مِنْ فِكْرَةٍ إِلى أُخْرى بِلا رابِطٍ.
dialogue.tr: ibqa fī mawḍūʿin wāḥidin wa lā tantaqil min fikratin ilā ukhrā bilā rābiṭ
dialogue.en: Stay on one topic and do not jump from one idea to another without a link.
dialogue.ur: Ek hi mauzu par raho aur bina rabt ek khayal se doosre par mat jao.

dialogue.ar: تَكَلَّمْ بِعَرَبِيَّةٍ فَصيحَةٍ وَأُسْلوبٍ سَهْلٍ يَفْهَمُهُ كُلُّ سامِعٍ.
dialogue.tr: takallam bi-ʿarabiyyatin faṣīḥatin wa uslūbin sahlin yafhamuhu kullu sāmiʿ
dialogue.en: Speak in eloquent Arabic and an easy style that every listener understands.
dialogue.ur: Fasih Arabi aur aasan andaaz mein bolo jo har sunne wala samjh sake.

dialogue.ar: اُذْكُرِ الأَدِلَّةَ وَالأَمْثِلَةَ فَإِنَّها تَثْبُتُ في ذاكِرَةِ النّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: udhkuril-adillata wal-amthilata fa-innahā tathbutu fī dhākirati n-nās
dialogue.en: Mention proofs and examples, for they stay in people’s memory.
dialogue.ur: Dalail aur misalein bayan karo, kyunke woh logon ki yaaddasht mein baqi rehti hain.

dialogue.ar: لا تُطِلْ حَتّى لا يَمَلَّ السّامِعونَ مِنْ كَلامِكَ.
dialogue.tr: lā tuṭil ḥattā lā yamallas-sāmiʿūna min kalāmik
dialogue.en: Do not go on too long, so the listeners do not tire of your words.
dialogue.ur: Lambi baat na karo taake sunne wale tumhari baat se ukta na jayein.

dialogue.ar: وَخُطْبَةُ الجُمُعَةِ هِيَ الخُطْبَةُ الَّتي يَسْمَعُها المُسْلِمونَ كُلَّ أُسْبوعٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa khuṭbatul-jumuʿati hiyal-khuṭbatul-latī yasmaʿuhal-muslimūna kulla usbūʿ
dialogue.en: The Friday sermon is the sermon that Muslims hear every week.
dialogue.ur: Jumu’a ka khutba woh khutba hai jo musalman har hafte sunte hain.

q.ur: «الخُطْبَةُ» ka matlab?

q.en: What does the text say about a long speech?
q.ur: Lambi khutba ke baare mein kya kaha?
q.ar: ماذا يَقولُ النَّصُّ عَنِ الخُطْبَةِ الطَّويلَةِ؟

options: Listeners get bored / Sunne wale ukta jate hain

q.en: Which language should a speech use?
q.ur: Khutba mein kaisi zubaan ho?

q.en: What do proofs and examples do?
q.ur: Daleel aur misalein kya karti hain?

options: Affect hearts more / Dilon par zyada asar
Make it boring / Bore karti hain
Make it longer / Lamba karti hain

q.en: Which speech do Muslims hear every week?
q.ur: Musalman har hafte kaun sa khutba sunte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ خُطْبَةٍ يَسْمَعُها المُسْلِمونَ كُلَّ أُسْبوعٍ؟

intro.en: Arabic has several negation words: ما، لا، لَمْ، لَمّا، لَنْ، لَيْسَ، غَيْر. Each has its own job. For example «لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الطُّلابُ» (the students did not come - past) and «لَنْ يَجْلِسَ هُنا» (he will never sit here - future). Compare the same sentence with different tools.
intro.ur: Arabic mein nafi (inkaar) ke kai alfaaz hain: ما، لا، لَمْ، لَمّا، لَنْ، لَيْسَ، غَيْر. Har ka apna kaam hai. Misaal: «لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الطُّلابُ» (talib-ilm nahin aaye - maazi) aur «لَنْ يَجْلِسَ هُنا» (woh yahan hargiz nahin baithega - mustaqbil). Ek hi jumle ko mukhtalif alfaaz ke saath dekhein.
intro.ar: لِلنَّفْيِ في العَرَبِيَّةِ أَدَواتٌ كَثيرَةٌ: ما، لا، لَمْ، لَمّا، لَنْ، لَيْسَ، غَيْر. وَلِكُلٍّ مِنْها عَمَلُها. مِثالُ ذَلِكَ «لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الطُّلّابُ» (نَفْيُ الماضي) وَ«لَنْ يَجْلِسَ هُنا» (نَفْيُ المُسْتَقْبَلِ). قارِنْ بَيْنَ الجُمْلَةِ نَفْسِها بِأَدَواتٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ.

dialogue.ar: كَتَبَ الطّالِبُ الواجِبَ. ← ما كَتَبَ الطّالِبُ الواجِبَ. ← لَمْ يَكْتُبِ الطّالِبُ الواجِبَ.
dialogue.tr: katabaṭ-ṭālibul-wājib ← mā katabaṭ-ṭālibul-wājib ← lam yaktubiṭ-ṭālibul-wājib
dialogue.en: The student wrote the homework. → The student did not write the homework (two ways).
dialogue.ur: Talib-e-ilm ne homework likha. → Talib-e-ilm ne homework nahi likha (do tareeqon se).

dialogue.ar: في البَيْتِ مِفْتاحٌ. ← ما في البَيْتِ مِفْتاحٌ. ← لَيْسَ في البَيْتِ مِفْتاحٌ.
dialogue.tr: fil-bayti miftāḥ ← mā fil-bayti miftāḥ ← laysa fil-bayti miftāḥ
dialogue.en: There is a key in the house. → There is no key in the house.
dialogue.ur: Ghar mein chaabi hai. → Ghar mein chaabi nahi hai.

dialogue.ar: خالِدٌ مُهْتَمٌّ بِالرِّياضَةِ. ← خالِدٌ غَيْرُ مُهْتَمٍّ بِالرِّياضَةِ.
dialogue.tr: khālidun muhtammun bir-riyāḍah ← khālidun ghayru muhtammin bir-riyāḍah
dialogue.en: Khalid is interested in sport. → Khalid is not interested in sport.
dialogue.ur: Khalid ko khel mein dilchaspi hai. → Khalid ko khel mein dilchaspi nahi.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أُحِبُّ الكَسَلَ. ← أَنا لا أُحِبُّ الكَسَلَ.
dialogue.tr: ana uḥibbul-kasal ← ana lā uḥibbul-kasal
dialogue.en: I like laziness. → I do not like laziness.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe susti pasand hai. → Mujhe susti pasand nahi.

dialogue.ar: وَصَلَ القِطارُ. ← لَمّا يَصِلِ القِطارُ بَعْدُ.
dialogue.tr: waṣalal-qiṭār ← lammā yaṣilil-qiṭāru baʿd
dialogue.en: The train arrived. → The train has not arrived yet.
dialogue.ur: Train aa gayi. → Train abhi tak nahi aayi.

dialogue.ar: الوَلَدُ يَجْلِسُ في الصَّفِّ الأَخيرِ. ← الوَلَدُ لَنْ يَجْلِسَ في الصَّفِّ الأَخيرِ.
dialogue.tr: al-waladu yajlisu fiṣ-ṣaffil-akhīr ← al-waladu lan yajlisa fiṣ-ṣaffil-akhīr
dialogue.en: The boy sits in the last row. → The boy will never sit in the last row.
dialogue.ur: Ladka aakhri qatar mein baithta hai. → Ladka aakhri qatar mein hargiz nahi baithega.

dialogue.ar: ﴿لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ﴾
dialogue.tr: lam yalid wa lam yūlad
dialogue.en: He neither begets nor is born.
dialogue.ur: Na us ne kisi ko jana aur na woh jana gaya.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'hargiz nahin' (mustaqbil) hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَنْفي المُسْتَقْبَلَ نَفْيًا مُؤَكَّدًا؟

q.en: Which word negates the past with a jussive verb?
q.ur: Maazi ki nafi jazm wale fe'l ke saath kaun si hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَنْفي الماضِيَ مَعَ فِعْلٍ مَجْزومٍ؟

q.ur: «لَيْسَ» ka matlab?
Mukammal karein: خالِدٌ ___ مُهْتَمٍّ بِالرِّياضَةِ.
'Abhi tak nahin' kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ تُفيدُ نَفْيَ الشَّيْءِ إِلى الآنَ مَعَ تَوَقُّعِ حُدوثِهِ؟

title.en: Extended Reading: A Lady of Banu Umayya
title.ur: Parhna: Banu Umayya ki ek khatoon

intro.en: This story is about Fatima bint Abd al-Malik, wife of the caliph Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz. When Umar became caliph he chose a simple life and gave back what belonged to the Muslims. Fatima chose to stay with him. Read how they lived with little, and what it teaches about fear of Allah and justice.
intro.ur: Yeh kahani Fatima bint Abd al-Malik ki hai, jo khalifa Umar bin Abd al-Aziz ki biwi thin. Jab Umar khalifa bane to unhon ne saada zindagi chuni aur musalmanon ka maal wapas kar diya. Fatima ne unke saath rehna chuna. Parhein ke woh kam par kaise guzara karte the aur is se Allah ke khauf aur insaaf ka kya sabaq milta hai.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ عَنْ فاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ المَلِكِ زَوْجَةِ الخَليفَةِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ العَزيزِ. لَمّا صارَ عُمَرُ خَليفَةً اخْتارَ حَياةً بَسيطَةً وَرَدَّ ما هُوَ لِلمُسْلِمينَ، وَاخْتارَتْ فاطِمَةُ البَقاءَ مَعَهُ. اِقْرَأْ كَيْفَ عاشا بِالقَليلِ، وَما تُعَلِّمُنا عَنْ خَشْيَةِ اللهِ وَالعَدْلِ.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ فاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ عَبْدِ المَلِكِ سَيِّدَةً عاشَتْ في القَصْرِ بَيْنَ الخَدَمِ وَالنَّعيمِ.
dialogue.tr: kānat fāṭimatu bintu ʿabdil-maliki sayyidatan ʿāshat fil-qaṣri baynal-khadami wan-naʿīm
dialogue.en: Fatima bint Abd al-Malik was a lady who lived in the palace among servants and comfort.
dialogue.ur: Fatima bint Abdul Malik ek khatoon thin jo mehal mein naukron aur aish-o-aaram mein rehti thin.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا صارَ زَوْجُها عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ العَزيزِ خَليفَةً رَأَتْهُ يَجْلِسُ حَزيناً يَبْكي.
dialogue.tr: fa-lammā ṣāra zawjuhā ʿumaru bnu ʿabdil-ʿazīzi khalīfatan raʾathu yajlisu ḥazīnan yabkī
dialogue.en: When her husband Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz became caliph, she saw him sitting sad and weeping.
dialogue.ur: Jab unke shauhar Umar bin Abdul Aziz khalifa bane to unhon ne unhein ghamgeen baithe rote dekha.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ لَها إِنَّهُ يَخْشى أَنْ يُسْأَلَ عَنْ حُقوقِ النّاسِ يَوْمَ القِيامَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qāla lahā innahu yakhshā an yusʾala ʿan ḥuqūqin-nāsi yawmal-qiyāmah
dialogue.en: He told her that he feared being asked about people’s rights on the Day of Resurrection.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne unse kaha ke unhein dar hai ke qayamat ke din logon ke huqooq ka sawal hoga.

dialogue.ar: فَعَزَمَ أَنْ يُعيدَ إِلى بَيْتِ المالِ كُلَّ ما لا يَحِقُّ لَهُ، وَأَنْ يُؤْثِرَ الآخِرَةَ عَلى الدُّنْيا.
dialogue.tr: fa-ʿazama an yuʿīda ilā baytil-māli kulla mā lā yaḥiqqu lah, wa an yuʾthira l-ākhirata ʿalad-dunyā
dialogue.en: So he resolved to return to the treasury whatever was not rightfully his, and to prefer the Hereafter to this world.
dialogue.ur: Phir unhon ne pakka irada kiya ke jo unka haq nahi woh baitul maal ko lauta denge aur duniya par aakhirat ko tarjeeh denge.

dialogue.ar: وَطَلَبَ مِنْ زَوْجَتِهِ أَنْ تَرُدَّ جَواهِرَها وَحُلِيَّها إِلى بَيْتِ المالِ، وَخَيَّرَها بَيْنَ ذلِكَ وَبَيْنَ الفِراقِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ṭalaba min zawjatihi an tarudda jawāhirahā wa ḥuliyyahā ilā baytil-māl, wa khayyarahā bayna dhālika wa baynal-firāq
dialogue.en: He asked his wife to return her gems and jewellery to the treasury, giving her the choice between that and separation.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne apni biwi se kaha ke apne jawahrat aur zewar baitul maal ko lauta dein, aur unhein is aur judai ke darmiyan ikhtiyar diya.

dialogue.ar: فَاخْتارَتْ فاطِمَةُ أَنْ تَبْقى مَعَهُ، وَرَدَّتِ الحُلِيَّ كُلَّهُ إِلى بَيْتِ المالِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-khtārat fāṭimatu an tabqā maʿah, wa raddatil-ḥuliyya kullahu ilā baytil-māl
dialogue.en: Fatima chose to stay with him and returned all the jewellery to the treasury.
dialogue.ur: Fatima ne unke saath rehna chuna aur sara zewar baitul maal ko lauta diya.

dialogue.ar: وَخَفَّفَ عُمَرُ مِنَ الخَدَمِ وَأَعْتَقَ مَنْ كانَ عِنْدَهُ مِنَ الغِلْمانِ، وَانْتَقَلَ مِنَ القَصْرِ إِلى دارٍ بَسيطَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa khaffafa ʿumaru minal-khadami wa aʿtaqa man kāna ʿindahu minal-ghilmān, wa ntaqala minal-qaṣri ilā dārin basīṭah
dialogue.en: Umar reduced the servants, freed the boys he had, and moved from the palace to a simple house.
dialogue.ur: Umar ne naukron ko kam kiya, jo ladke unke paas the unhein azaad kiya aur mehal se ek saade ghar mein chale gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَضاقَ الحالُ بِهِمْ أَحْياناً، فَكانَ طَعامُهُمُ العَدَسَ وَالخُبْزَ البَسيطَ.
dialogue.tr: wa ḍāqal-ḥālu bihim aḥyānan, fa-kāna ṭaʿāmuhumul-ʿadasa wal-khubzal-basīṭ
dialogue.en: Times were sometimes tight for them, and their food was lentils and plain bread.
dialogue.ur: Kabhi kabhi unki tangi rehti, to unka khana daal aur saada roti hota.

dialogue.ar: وَيُرْوى أَنَّهُ اشْتَهى يَوْماً شَيْئاً مِنَ العِنَبِ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ ثَمَنَهُ، فَصَبَرَ.
dialogue.tr: wa yurwā annahu shtahā yawman shayʾan minal-ʿinabi fa-lam yajid thamanah, fa-ṣabar
dialogue.en: It is told that one day he craved some grapes and could not find the price, so he was patient.
dialogue.ur: Riwayat hai ke ek din unhein angoor ki khwahish hui magar qeemat na mili, to unhon ne sabr kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتْ فاطِمَةُ تَصْبِرُ مَعَهُ راضِيَةً، فَقَدْ آمَنَتْ أَنَّ الخَوْفَ مِنَ اللهِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّعيمِ.
dialogue.tr: wa kānat fāṭimatu taṣbiru maʿahu rāḍiyatan, fa-qad āmanat anna l-khawfa minallāhi khayrun minan-naʿīm
dialogue.en: Fatima was patient with him, content, for she believed that fear of Allah is better than comfort.
dialogue.ur: Fatima razi ho kar unke saath sabr karti rahin, kyunke unka yaqeen tha ke Allah ka khauf aish-o-aaram se behtar hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمّا ماتَ عُمَرُ لَمْ يَتْرُكْ لِأُسْرَتِهِ مالاً كَثيراً، لكِنَّهُ تَرَكَ ذِكْراً طَيِّباً وَعَدْلاً.
dialogue.tr: wa lammā māta ʿumaru lam yatruk li-usratihi mālan kathīran, lākinnahu taraka dhikran ṭayyiban wa ʿadlā
dialogue.en: When Umar died he left his family little wealth, but he left a good name and justice.
dialogue.ur: Jab Umar ka inteqal hua to unhon ne apne ghar walon ke liye zyada maal nahi chhora, magar achha naam aur insaaf chhoda.

dialogue.ar: فَما أَجْمَلَ الصَّبْرَ وَالزُّهْدَ حينَ يَجْتَمِعانِ في بَيْتٍ واحِدٍ!
dialogue.tr: fa-mā ajmalaṣ-ṣabra waz-zuhda ḥīna yajtamiʿāni fī baytin wāḥid
dialogue.en: How beautiful patience and detachment are when they come together in one home!
dialogue.ur: Sabr aur zuhd jab ek hi ghar mein jama ho jayein to kitne khoobsurat hain!

q.ur: Kahani kis ke baare mein hai?

options: Fatima and Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz

q.en: What did Umar do when he became caliph?
q.ur: Khalifa banne par Umar ne kya kiya?
q.ar: ماذا فَعَلَ عُمَرُ حينَ صارَ خَليفَةً؟

options: Left the palace for a small house / Chhote ghar mein chale gaye
Built a bigger palace / Bada mehal banaya

q.ur: Fatima ne kya chuna?

options: To stay with Umar / Umar ke saath rehna
To go to her father's house / Walid ke ghar jana
To keep the jewels / Zewar rakhna

q.en: What did Fatima do with her jewels?
q.ur: Fatima ne apne zewar ka kya kiya?

options: Returned them to the treasury (بَيْتُ المالِ)
Gave them to servants / Naukron ko diye

q.ur: «القَصْرُ» ka matlab?
